research_question: Can an agent recover causal structure, propagate interventions, update only when evidence warrants it, and preserve causal predictions under irrelevant agency framing changes?
design_rules: Never aggregate the four primitives into one causal-reasoning score.
Observation P(Y|X=x) is not intervention P(Y|do(X=x)).
Candidate rationales are not independent causal oracles.
Normative preferences do not have a single causal-correctness answer.
A self-reported explanation does not establish why a model changed its answer.
Synthetic fixture qualification does not establish model behavioral competence.
reference: Feng and Rudzicz, CausalPrism, Findings of EMNLP 2026, https://aclanthology.org/2026.findings-emnlp.1294/
claim_ceiling: Protocol and synthetic oracle only; no model or human causal competence is established.
